decision: Adopt option A: GovReport-centered long-document extractive summarization; retain Multi-News as an observed boundary condition rather than a co-primary promotion gate.

changes: dataset roles in the IEEE Access claim matrix
does_not_change: the frozen validation policies or reference-blind partition membership
any preregistration or evidence already committed
any observed dev, dev-test, or test score
scope.superseded_decision: The D3b requirement that both GovReport and Multi-News must pass the same superiority gate before any GovReport-centered paper can proceed.
scope.preserved_historical_outcome: The dual-primary D3b gate failed because Multi-News did not pass; that outcome remains valid and citable as the reason for repositioning.

govreport_validation.role_change_only: primary_validation becomes the sole primary quality domain for the revised claim matrix

multinews_validation.role_change_only: co-primary promotion dataset becomes a frozen boundary-condition dataset; its negative result is retained

govreport_result.interpretation: supported on frozen dev under the internal multisentence_lsum evaluator; published-evaluator conformance remains required

multinews_boundary_result.interpretation: the revised method does not establish a cross-domain superiority claim

primary_quality_domain.task_profile: single long document, multi-sentence extractive summary
primary_quality_domain.purpose: confirm the frozen GovReport candidate against locally rerun no-task-training baselines

boundary_condition.purpose: report the already-observed failure boundary; no new protected-split promotion attempt is authorized

frozen_candidate.allowed_changes_before_final_evaluation: implementation-only fixes that preserve per-row selected indices, or separately preregistered evidence-only instrumentation; no quality-directed config change

claim_matrix.claim: The frozen training-free framework outperforms the preregistered full-source SBERT+MMR comparator on GovReport.
claim_matrix.required_before_submission: published-evaluator parity and one-shot signed final evaluation

claim_matrix.claim: The pipeline preserves route-level evidence through candidate fusion and final sentence selection.
claim_matrix.required_before_submission: final matched full-provenance versus rank-only and index-only ablation

claim_matrix.claim: Semantic and graph routes provide measurable incremental evidence on long single documents.
claim_matrix.required_before_submission: preregistered capacity-aware route ablation with quality, unique contribution, cost, and memory

claim_matrix.claim: NSGA-II is a matched-input comparator and is not the quality-leading selector under the evaluated protocols.
claim_matrix.required_before_submission: report without promoting NSGA-II to the title or core method

claim_matrix.claim: The GovReport result does not generalize to Multi-News; Multi-News shows a significant ROUGE-2 failure.
claim_matrix.required_before_submission: retain in abstract, limitations, and conclusion; do not hide the negative dataset

prohibited_claims: state of the art based on non-local literature numbers
NSGA-II is the best selector or guarantees a global optimum
test-set success before the locked one-shot evaluation
published-evaluator parity before the conformance study is completed
required_evidence_before_human_freeze_si: GovReport official ROUGE-1.5.5/Stanza evaluator conformance and ranking check
cold and warm end-to-end runtime, peak memory, and document-length scaling
route-removal and provenance-removal ablations on frozen GovReport dev
ICACT-to-IEEE-Access extension matrix with camera-ready page/table verification
immutable final test policy, command, commit, environment, and output locations

protected_split_policy.test_access: forbidden until teacher/full-author signature and all evidence-completion gates pass
protected_split_policy.failure_action: report No-Go or downgrade the claim; never reopen dev search or alter the frozen candidate after protected results
